legal.about: FordCast is an independent student project made for the 2026 Congressional App Challenge. This demonstration uses simulated gauge readings and simulated storms; no alert in it is real. It is not an official warning service and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Weather Service, USGS, the City of Austin, Travis County, or the U.S. House of Representatives. FordCast never indicates that a crossing is safe. Always obey barricades, road closures, and official warnings. In an emergency, call 911. Provided "as is," without warranty of any kind.
